rules.title: Allowable annual rent increase, March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
rules.requirement: For a rent-controlled San Francisco unit, the annual increase your landlord can impose for March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%. Check that any annual increase notice in this period does not exceed it.

coverage.summary: Units subject to the San Francisco Rent Ordinance's allowable annual increase. This page does not describe which buildings are covered.

rules.citation: San Francisco Rent Ordinance (S.F. Rent Board allowable annual increase, Form 571)

rules.title: Relocation payments for owner/relative move-in, demolition/removal, temporary capital improvement, or substantial rehabilitation evictions
rules.requirement: If you are served an eviction notice between 3/1/26 and 2/28/27 for owner or relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation, you are owed $8,245 per tenant, up to $24,733 per unit. Each elderly (60+) or disabled tenant, or household with minor children, gets an additional $5,497.
rules.key_value: $8,245 per tenant; max $24,733 per unit; plus $5,497 per elderly (60+), disabled, or minor-child household

coverage.summary: Tenants in San Francisco units covered by Rent Ordinance § 37.9C who are evicted for the listed no-fault reasons. Temporary capital improvement evictions of less than 20 days are instead governed by Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9.

rules.exemptions: Temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days are governed by Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9 instead.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.interaction: The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions of less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9, not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.

rules.title: Relocation payments for Ellis Act evictions
rules.requirement: If you are served an Ellis Act eviction notice between 3/1/26 and 2/28/27, you are owed $11,110.05 per tenant, up to $33,330.13 per unit. Each elderly (62+) or disabled tenant gets an additional $7,443.90.
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant; max $33,330.13 per unit; plus $7,443.90 per elderly (62+) or disabled tenant

coverage.summary: Tenants in San Francisco evicted under the Ellis Act (withdrawal of units from the rental market).

rules.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act

notes: This is an SF Rent Board rate table, not ordinance text. Building coverage for the 1.6% allowable increase is not described on the page. The rent-increase citation is not stated on the page, so the generic Rent Ordinance reference is used. Section numbers for the relocation records are taken from the page's references to Rent Ordinance §§ 37.9C and 37.9A. Not extracted as separate records: (1) the security deposit interest rate (4.2%), because the page cites no governing law section and the security_deposits category covers maximum deposits; (2) the $446/day temporary displacement payment (under 20 days, plus actual moving expenses) governed by Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9, a state statute mentioned only by reference; (3) Rent Board fees, capital improvement imputed interest rates, and uncompensated labor rates, which are out of scope.
